title: LagLog
description: A command that shows information related to your server's performance and why it could be lagging, such as TPS, TPS alerts, entities loaded, chunks loaded, and chunk with the highest entity count.
body:
# **Ever Wondered Why Your Server is Lagging** #

**Well now you can know!** LagLog is a one-command tool that gives information about why your server could be lagging, such as the most entity-dense chunk per world, or chunk/entity counts. Also alerts you if your server TPS is under 15, so it's recommended to use this when you get an alert.

## **How to use LagLog** ##
You can either use LagLog from the server console or by either being an operator or getting the permission. Just use /lag and you will see the information listed below, it should look something like this:

Entities: 85. Loaded Chunks: 625. Worst Chunk: 4, -1 (7 entities)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9db2828557d55af11116bdcb55adf071f40842a.png)
